title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Odometer Reading for a Kept-Vehicle Refund
content:
**Rule.** For a kept-vehicle refund on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the unused mileage share is measured at a reading. The reading is the first of the following that applies:
1. **Latest group repair order.** Where the latest repair order a group store wrote for the vehicle records an odometer above the certified one, that repair-order odometer. The latest repair order is the one whose labor was closed last; where two closed labor on the same day, it is the one listed first in the service records of Service Accounts and Repair Orders.
2. **Latest Kessler Care visit.** Where no such repair order does, the latest visit redeemed on the Kessler Care plan sold on the contract's purchase deal is used, provided it has not been reinstated. A contract sold on its own has no such plan. Where that visit records an odometer above the certified one, the reading is that visit odometer. The plan is a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan.
3. **Otherwise,** the certified odometer.

**Truth table (hypothetical, certified odometer 58200).**

| Latest group repair order odometer | Latest Kessler Care visit on the deal's plan | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 59140 | 59900, not reinstated | 59140 |
| 58200 | 59900, not reinstated | 59900 |
| 57700 | 59900, reinstated | 58200 |
| none | none (contract sold on its own) | 58200 |

A repair-order odometer equal to the certified one is not above it, so the first case does not apply.
